The LLM is instructed to populate this alongside each value.

description:
Single-call extraction result for one Telegram message.

Invariants enforced by validators:
- If is_relevant=False, all market fields MUST be null.
- volume and price are Decimal to avoid floating-point comparison bugs in eval.
- currency is uppercased and validated as 3-char ISO 4217 code.
- confidence is the overall score; <0.5 routes to needs_review queue.

is_relevant.description: True if the message contains a polymer market signal.
is_relevant.title: Is Relevant

kind.description: Signal type matching signal_kind DB enum.

product.description: Polymer code: PP, HDPE, LDPE, LLDPE, PVC, PET, PS, ABS, etc.
product.title: Product

grade_text.description: Grade/specification verbatim from source. Null if not mentioned.
grade_text.title: Grade Text

volume.description: Volume in metric tonnes. Null if not stated.
volume.title: Volume

price.description: Unit price. Null if not stated.
price.title: Price

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code: USD, UZS, RUB, CNY, EUR.
currency.title: Currency

region.description: Market/region of the event. Null if not determinable.
region.title: Region

counterparty_text.description: Counterparty name verbatim. Null if not mentioned.
counterparty_text.title: Counterparty Text

urgency.description: Urgency level inferred from language cues.

lead_score.description: Lead quality score 0–1. Populated by lead-scoring pass, not extraction.
lead_score.title: Lead Score

confidence.description: Overall extraction confidence. <0.5 routes to needs_review queue.
confidence.title: Confidence

event_at.description: Original event timestamp ISO-8601 (UTC). For forwarded messages set to fwd_from.date, not fetch time. Null if not determinable.
event_at.title: Event At

is_forwarded.description: True if the Telegram message was forwarded from another channel. Set by the userbot from fwd_from, not by the LLM.
is_forwarded.title: Is Forwarded
